narrative_vs_numbers.point: PAT grew steadily from 13,481 crore in Dec 2025 to 17,389 crore in Sep 2026.
Revenue YoY improved significantly to 16.2% in Sep 2026 compared to 2.8% in Dec 2025.
Borrowings increased sharply from 220,264 crore in Mar 2026 to 295,561 crore in Sep 2026.

bull: PAT grew 21.4% year-on-year to 17,389 crore in Sep 2026.
Revenue growth accelerated to 16.2% YoY in Sep 2026.
Equity base expanded to 387,662 crore by Sep 2026 with a D/E of 0.76.
bear: Operating cash flow dropped to 67,325 crore in Mar 2026 from 122,805 crore in Mar 2025.
